items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley and WR DeVonta Smith officially off injury report, good to go MNF vs Bears. Hollywood Brown OUT.
items.why: Off report after limited then full; positive MRI/stinger
items.implication: Start both confidently; full roles expected
items.opportunity: Barkley lead back; Smith primary WR

items.text: Bears officially ruled out Caleb Williams for MNF vs Eagles; Tyson Bagent full participant, officially QUESTIONABLE, back at practice.
items.implication: Bears offense downgrade; Bagent stream/DFS dart if active; Chicago pass-catchers volatile
items.opportunity: Bagent opportunity; monitor WR/TE usage shift

items.text: ETR Sunday injury list: Puka Nacua DOUBTFUL (hip/groin). Not expected to play per beat/insider alignment; Adams elevated target/route share without him.
items.why: Did not practice; McVay progress slow; historical 1-2 week groin/hip
items.implication: Adams WR1/top-12 upside; monitor Whittington return but Adams 40%+ target rate prior
items.opportunity: Adams routes/targets sans Nacua (60/142 prior, 42% rate)

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT (toe); Jaylen Warren QUESTIONABLE (shoulder) but lead back expected. ETR projects Warren in.
items.why: Steelers ruled Dowdle out; coach: Warren lead group, breathers as needed
items.implication: Warren workhorse/RB2-FLEX with checkdown upside vs CIN; Homer/Heidenreich backups
items.opportunity: Warren lead carries + routes; vertical pass failing so checkdowns spam likely

items.text: Broncos RB Jonah Coleman high-ankle sprain, short-term IR, miss next few games; expected back late Oct vs Cards. Hit to depth with Dobbins/Harvey returning.
items.implication: Dobbins/Harvey clear lead roles; reverse any Coleman stash

items.text: Colts placed WR Alec Pierce on IR, elevated Nick Westbrook-Ikhine; signed Gould.
items.implication: Colts WR depth thin; Downs/Pittman/others elevated; longer absence

items.text: Projecting Qs Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN for Sunday. Hoping early clarity on Flowers (ham), Mitchell (finger), DJ Moore (shoulder). Big DFS implications from ETR list.
items.why: LP/practice trends + internal models; official listings pending
items.implication: Start Warren/Evans/Bowers if active; monitor Flowers closely
items.opportunity: Full roles if cleared; Bowers TE upside

items.text: Commanders Jayden Daniels OUT this week (elbow, no surgery/IR expected longer-term positive); Marcus Mariota starts. Good news on longer outlook.
items.implication: McLaurin/WAS pass-catchers downgrade short-term but not tanked; Mariota stream risky
items.opportunity: Mariota game; McLaurin ~25% share historical with him

items.text: JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey IN (full participants); Malik Nabers IN; Travis Etienne IN; Jadarian Price IN. Jonah Coleman OUT/IR context.
items.implication: Start Dobbins/Harvey confidently in expanded roles; Nabers/Etienne full go
items.opportunity: Broncos RB snaps to healthy duo; Nabers WR1 volume

items.text: ETR Week 3 main slate projections live: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new record ceiling at 44.0 (top 25th %ile sim avg). Updates for news.
items.why: Sim ceiling record; Lions usage/opportunity elite
items.implication: Must-start RB1 with massive upside; DFS tournament priority

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren leads Steelers RBs; expecting zillion checkdowns as vertical game failed for Rodgers. Projecting Warren (Q shoulder) in; Homer + rookie Heidenreich backups.
items.why: Coach explicit lead + freshness plan; practice limited but in proj
items.implication: High-volume RB2/FLEX; ceiling via receptions if limited run game

items.text: With Nico Collins out last week, Dalton Schultz targeted 30% routes, team-high 28% share. Week 3 vs Colts (4th most TE yards allowed).
items.implication: Schultz strong TE start/stream while Collins out
items.opportunity: High target rate on routes; Colts weak vs TE

items.text: After Stevenson 1Q fumble, Henderson led NE backfield 65% snaps, out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but still ranks Stevenson ahead Week 3 (pass pro trust).

items.implication: Henderson stash/flex rising but Stevenson still preferred start
